title: FreeCast Thanks Bill Jennings for His Board Service - Press Release - FreeCast
summary: FreeCast, Inc. recognizes Bill Jennings for his service and contributions to the company's Board of Directors following his departure on November 6, 2026.
body_markdown:
ORLANDO, Fla.- FreeCast, Inc. (NASDAQ: CAST), a provider of white-label streaming and media monetization software, today expressed its appreciation to departing director Bill Jennings for his service and commitment to the Company. His departure was effective November 6, 2026.


“On behalf of FreeCast and our Board, I thank Bill for his dedication and contributions,” said William Mobley, Founder and CEO of FreeCast. “We appreciate his service and wish him continued success.”


FreeCast also looks forward to announcing the newest members of its Board of Directors in the coming days, subject to completion of the applicable appointment procedures.
